question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Disgust
solution:
The correct answer is: Dislike

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Disgust means a strong feeling of not liking or approving of something/somebody that you feel is unacceptable.

 
 
• Example -* The film was so bad that we walked out in **disgust**.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Dislike means the feeling of not liking somebody/something.
 
 
• Example -* He seems to have a strong **dislike **of hard work.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Disgust' and 'Dislike' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Desire means the feeling of wanting something very much; a strong wish.
 
• Doubt means a feeling of not knowing what to believe or what to do.
 
• Danger means the chance that somebody/something may be hurt, killed, or damaged or that something bad may happen.
